# Introduction

# Methods

## Data sources

PORDATA (regional births by NUTS II/III, annual) and the Transparência SNS *Partos e Cesarianas* dataset (deliveries per hospital, monthly).

## Cross-regional flow index

For hospital `h` in Região de Saúde `r` in year `t`:

$$\text{Expected}(h,r,t) = \text{TotalBirths}(r,t) \times \frac{\text{Capacity}(h,t)}{\sum_{h' \in r} \text{Capacity}(h',t)}$$

The flow index is `Observed − Expected`.

## Statistical approach

One-sample t-test against zero; mixed-effects model `lmer(flow ~ year + (1 | hospital))`; Moran's I for spatial autocorrelation.
